title: SNMP: Fix responses from different ports and SMUX
description:
Fixup 14d398fe67c1da7b1554a52714b513d86f78e424

That commit added support for request / response tracking, but broke
the handling of SNMP agents, like the original OS/400 implementation,
that send the response from a different, ephemeral port instead of the
SNMP port. Instead of creating a conversation with a wildcarded port,
it created an extra conversation with full address and port information.
This also had a side effect of creating empty extra UDP streams for
Follow Stream.

It also caused SMUX to always fail with a DISSECTOR ASSERT, because
the entry point to SMUX isn't dissect_snmp_pdu, so the conversation
data was never set up for requests and responses.

Part of #17890.
